description: A login page script for the TestLink open source project, handling configuration checks, session management, OAuth integration, and login form rendering.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and parses login request parameters, determining the action to perform.

methods.name: validateOauth
methods.description: Validates the OAuth provider name against configured whitelist.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Initializes GUI elements and configuration for the login page, including OAuth buttons and background image.

methods.name: doBlockingChecks
methods.description: Checks database schema version and blocks login if schema is incompatible.

methods.name: renderLoginScreen
methods.description: Renders the login page using Smarty templates.

methods.name: authorizePostProcessing
methods.description: Handles post-authentication actions such as redirecting or displaying success/failure messages.

methods.name: processAjaxCheck
methods.description: Returns JSON indicating session validity and localized labels for AJAX login checks.

methods.name: cleanInput
methods.description: Sanitizes input to remove scripts, HTML tags, styles, and comments.
